title: TaskOutput
description: The normalized output of a run, shared by TaskResult and the completed and cancelled stream terminal outcomes (ADR 016). 'type' describes the content representation, not the task: 'text' carries inline text, 'playback' reports a managed, audible effect that has no retrievable bytes, and 'artifact' references retrievable media (ADR 017). A playback output is never an artifact, and an artifact output never implies that anything was played.

type.title: TaskOutputType
type.description: The content representation: 'text', 'playback' or 'artifact'. 'prepared' ends a prepare() run, carries no content, and lists each item in 'preparation'.

text.description: The text the run produced. Required when type is 'text'.

playback.title: PlaybackOutput
playback.description: Completion of managed playback. Required when type is 'playback'. Carries no media.

timing.title: PlaybackTiming
timing.description: What the provider measured about the playback. Absent when it measured nothing. 'firstAudioMs' and 'firstChunkMs' count from the same origin: the moment the provider's run() or stream() started handling the request, so their difference is the provider's output latency. The span includes everything the provider does after it starts handling the request (queue wait, voice lookup, a cold model load) and excludes routing.

durationMs.description: How long audible playback lasted, in milliseconds. For a cancelled run, how long it played before it was stopped, when the provider reports it.

firstAudioMs.description: Milliseconds from the provider receiving the request until the platform's first audible-output callback (for a system voice, its first word callback) or the first audio frame leaving the output. Absent when nothing reports it.

firstChunkMs.description: Milliseconds from the provider receiving the request until its first playable PCM chunk existed. Absent when the provider does not synthesize PCM itself.

artifact.description: The retrievable media the run produced. Required when type is 'artifact'.

preparation.description: What a prepare() run did, one item per provider and task. Required when type is 'prepared'. One failed item does not fail the run.

providerId.description: The provider this item belongs to.

task.description: The task kind this item belongs to.

status.title: PreparationStatus
status.description: 'prepared': this run made it ready. 'already_ready': nothing was needed. 'skipped': it needs a download that neither autoDownload nor allowDownload permits. 'failed': see reason.

reason.description: Why the item was skipped or failed.

voiceId.description: The voice this item prepared, when one was bound.

speech.title: SpeechOutput
speech.description: The locale and voice a text-to-speech run actually used, so an unmet preference is visible without being an error.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag of the locale that was spoken.

voice.title: SpeechOutputVoice
voice.description: The voice that spoke, as the catalog lists it.

id.description: The voice's id, when its provider lists one.

name.description: The voice's display label, when its provider lists one.
